# WHAT THEY SENT US INSTEAD: THE LETTERS [color=#7B776F]Pinned. Copy the official letters you were given, word for word. Leave out your own name and your person's. We are looking for the same sentences.[/color]
### #1 porch_light (mod) (OP) // 83.02.14 The first thing every family gets is a letter. Over the years we have noticed they are not written fresh. Some of them share whole sentences, across colonies, across years. Post yours here and we will mark the ones that match.
### #2 sister_of_mira // 83.02.15 Mine, from the Company personnel office: [italic]Your relative has been reassigned to a project of strategic priority. In accordance with project security, personal correspondence will be held and delivered at the end of the assignment. We thank you for your understanding and for your family's contribution to building better worlds.[/italic]
End of the assignment. They do not say when that is.
### #3 papa_of_tomas // 83.02.16 The mine sent me a death certificate. Cause of death: [italic]traumatic asphyxia, remains unrecoverable.[/italic] Signed by a Company medical officer. Dated the day before the shift went down.
I wrote to ask how a doctor certifies a death the day before it happens. They sent a new certificate with a different date. Same signature. They did not send an apology. They sent a compensation form with a clause that says I agree not to discuss the circumstances.
### #4 porch_light (mod) // 83.02.16 Marking: the phrase [italic]a project of strategic priority[/italic] appears in nine letters on this board from five colonies. The phrase [italic]remains unrecoverable[/italic] appears in fourteen.
### #5 wife_of_aleks // 83.03.11 The colonial administrator: [italic]The survey team's area of operation is now subject to operational security at the request of the garrison. Enquiries regarding personnel should be directed to the garrison.[/italic]
The garrison: [italic]Enquiries regarding colonial personnel should be directed to the colonial administration.[/italic]
The Marshal: [italic]As the area is under military operational security, this office has no jurisdiction. We recommend you contact the employer.[/italic]
The employer is the administration. I have a circle of letters on my table and none of them have his name in them.
### #6 lena_s_brother // 83.05.02 Clinic transfer notice: [italic]Patient transferred to a specialist medical facility for continued observation following quarantine exposure. Family visitation is not possible during observation. You will be notified of any change in condition.[/italic] It has a reference number on it. I asked the clinic what facility. The receptionist looked at the reference number and went white and said she could not discuss it, and then she said, very quietly, that I should not ask anyone else either.
### #7 quiet_mother // 83.05.06 I do not have an official letter. I have letters from my son. They still come, every forty days, on time. They are typed, and he never typed. They are always cheerful. The last three said the same thing about the weather in the same words.
In the last one he called me by my name. He has never once called me by my name. He calls me ma.
### #8 not_a_shift_boss // 83.05.07 Gone Quiet had a thread about this. Two identical letters from a mine on Chances Claim. They said it is what an autoresponder sends. I am sorry. I think you should read it.
### #9 porch_light (mod) // 83.05.14 quiet_mother, we have looked at the three letters you sent the mods. The weather paragraph is the same in all three, word for word, down to a missing comma. It is the pattern [netlink="Gone Quiet" link="missing.deep/silent"] logged from Chances Claim. We are so sorry. When you are ready, your son goes on the wall, and the wall will say he is missing, because he is, and no machine is going to tell us otherwise.
And for anyone who needs to hear it today: Jonah P. came home on the supply run last month. He is thin, and he will not talk about where he was, and he sleeps with the light on. But he is home. It happens. Keep your light on too.
